catalog.name: rdc_system_status
catalog.description: Get worker identity, permissions, capability status and counts.

catalog.name: rdc_diagnostics_status
catalog.description: Read bounded private incident categories and observed recovery outcomes. Does not repair code, replay actions, or change permissions.

catalog.name: rdc_preview_open
catalog.description: Show or reopen the live RDC preview inside a compatible AI app. Attaches to an existing browser or configured mobile session; closing the view leaves work running.

catalog.name: rdc_preview_frame
catalog.description: Read one live frame for the embedded RDC view. Does not create, close, pause, or mutate a browser or mobile session.

catalog.name: rdc_file_list
catalog.description: List a directory within the granted roots.

catalog.name: rdc_file_read
catalog.description: Read UTF-8 text with deterministic byte offsets and a SHA-256 version.

catalog.name: rdc_file_read_many
catalog.description: Read up to 20 independent files in one call. Per-file failures are retained.

catalog.name: rdc_file_search
catalog.description: Bounded literal content search; reports skipped files and truncation.

catalog.name: rdc_file_write
catalog.description: Atomically create a UTF-8 file. To replace, supply its current expected_sha256.

catalog.name: rdc_file_edit
catalog.description: Replace exact text after verifying SHA-256 and occurrence count. Uses file_path.

catalog.name: rdc_directory_create
catalog.description: Create one directory within granted roots. Its parent must exist.

catalog.name: rdc_job_start
catalog.description: Start an authorized command as a durable job. argv runs without shell expansion. Supply a shell explicitly when needed. Command permissions are those of the worker account.

catalog.name: rdc_job_status
catalog.description: Read persistent job state and exit status.

catalog.name: rdc_job_output
catalog.description: Read a retained stdout/stderr log. offset=0 always means the beginning; offsets are bytes.

catalog.name: rdc_job_list
catalog.description: List recent jobs, including completed jobs.

catalog.name: rdc_job_cancel
catalog.description: Request cancellation of an owned job and its process group.

catalog.name: rdc_job_input
catalog.description: Queue UTF-8 stdin for an interactive job. close=true closes its stdin after this input.

catalog.name: rdc_request_status
catalog.description: Read a persisted approval decision. Approval itself is owner-only.

catalog.name: rdc_credentials_list
catalog.description: List owner-configured opaque credential aliases and permitted website origins. Never returns passwords or provider locators.

catalog.name: rdc_credentials_request
catalog.description: Request a private saved-password fill into a freshly observed password input. Owner Allow Once or a matching persistent grant is required even in trusted mode. Never submits the form.

catalog.name: rdc_credentials_status
catalog.description: Read a credential request state without disclosing a password. Owner decisions are outside the agent catalog.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_start
catalog.description: Create a dedicated browser session. Playwright is headless with a fresh context. WebDriver uses the configured driver and capabilities.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_list
catalog.description: List active sessions in this daemon.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_observe
catalog.description: Read visible page text and current observation-bound control handles. Refresh before using stale handles.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_navigate
catalog.description: Navigate a session. Has worker network access, including local networks.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_click
catalog.description: Click a current observed control once. Uncertain failures are never retried.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_fill
catalog.description: Fill a current observed editable control once.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_pointer
catalog.description: Control the workspace pointer by CSS viewport coordinates, with a current observation.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_keys
catalog.description: Press a supported key or chord in the session; e.g. Enter, Tab, Control+A.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_screenshot
catalog.description: Capture the viewport. Returns bounded base64 image data.

catalog.name: rdc_browser_close
catalog.description: Close and discard one browser session.

catalog.name: rdc_desktop_status
catalog.description: Report explicit desktop mode and whether input is shared.

catalog.name: rdc_desktop_screenshot
catalog.description: Capture the explicitly enabled host desktop.

catalog.name: rdc_desktop_pointer
catalog.description: Control the explicitly enabled host desktop cursor in logical input coordinates. Scale screenshot positions by input_scale_x/y from a fresh desktop_screenshot. Shared mode uses the owner cursor.

catalog.name: rdc_desktop_keys
catalog.description: Press a key or chord on the explicitly enabled desktop.

catalog.name: rdc_desktop_type
catalog.description: Type ASCII text on the explicitly enabled desktop.

catalog.name: rdc_android_status
catalog.description: Query the owner-configured authorized ADB serial.

catalog.name: rdc_android_screenshot
catalog.description: Capture the owner-configured authorized Android device.

catalog.name: rdc_android_tap
catalog.description: Tap the owner-configured authorized Android device.

catalog.name: rdc_android_input
catalog.description: Type simple ASCII text through authorized ADB. Shell metacharacters are rejected.

catalog.name: rdc_android_key
catalog.description: Send an Android keycode name or integer through authorized ADB.

catalog.name: rdc_android_swipe
catalog.description: Swipe the owner-authorized Android device using native pixel coordinates.

catalog.name: rdc_android_long_press
catalog.description: Press and hold one point on the owner-authorized Android device.

catalog.name: rdc_android_launch_app
catalog.description: Launch an explicit Android package/activity on the owner-authorized device. Does not reset app data or grant permissions.

catalog.name: rdc_mobile_list
catalog.description: List owner-configured native mobile profiles and active sessions. Private connection details are omitted.

catalog.name: rdc_mobile_start
catalog.description: Start one native Appium session using an owner-configured profile. This may launch the configured app and use the selected device screen.

catalog.name: rdc_mobile_observe
catalog.description: Read bounded native labels and fresh control handles. Editable values and secure field labels are redacted.

catalog.name: rdc_mobile_tap
catalog.description: Tap a current observed native control once. No automatic retry follows an uncertain outcome.

catalog.name: rdc_mobile_fill
catalog.description: Replace text in a current nonsecure editable native control. Secure fields require owner input on the device.

catalog.name: rdc_mobile_swipe
catalog.description: Swipe in native logical coordinates from a current observation. Refresh the observation after any input.

catalog.name: rdc_mobile_screenshot
catalog.description: Capture the native screen only after privacy checks. Secure or unverifiable screens fail closed.

catalog.name: rdc_mobile_close
catalog.description: Close the exact native driver session. A failed cleanup remains listed for explicit recovery.
